{{Top|leg}}
'''AC-25''' was a sector in the [[Euclidean Complex]] in [[Rotkan]]. Visitors to the Euclidean Complex had to have visas stamped on their [[Intergalactic Passport]]s in order to enter Rotkan and were to be accompanied by guides at all times.
